title: Hotbar column: the bottom skill is tried first
body: Each hotbar key holds a column of up to 4 skills; a press tries the bottom one, then moves up past anything on cooldown or unusable.

title: Conflict: what sits at the bottom of a column
body: Cooldown skills at the bottom, no-cooldown filler on top (mein-mmo, playnews). allthings.how says put the no-cooldown attack at the bottom, which would starve the rest.

title: Macro entries point at hotbar slots, not skills
body: Each entry registers a whole hotbar column; changing the skills in that slot changes the macro.

title: Conflict: the order the editor runs its entries
body: Likely top to bottom: allthings.how says so and a KR editor frame numbers entries 1… from the top. mein-mmo says bottom up. Confirm in game.

title: The editor numbers its entries from the top
body: A KR Cleric's editor (May 2026) lists entries 1, 2, 3… downward, each with its own delay (10 ms); 'Add Macro' appends below.

title: Conflict: the basic attack inside the macro
body: KR Clerics interleave Earth's Retribution entries (Inven, a May 2026 video); mein-mmo and playnews keep it out and hold left click. Verdict on PC: keep it out.

title: Conflict: how long a chain can be
body: 4 skills per hotbar button (playnews) and up to 20 entries per macro (allthings.how); likely both, at different layers. Confirm in game.

title: Bind the macro key first; hold it to run
body: Unbound by default: Settings > Key Settings > General > Gameplay > Macro. Hold, don't tap; any manual input takes priority over the running macro.

title: Delay: 10 ms, raise only if skills drop
body: Each entry has a delay; the default fell from 50 to 10 ms. Try 40–50 ms only if skills fail to fire. It is input spacing, not ping.

title: Keep toggles, charged skills and long cooldowns out
body: A loop switches a toggle off (Light of Protection) and fires charged skills at charge 1 (Bolt); 45–60 s skills stall a fast loop.

title: Hold the basic attack beside the macro
body: Hold left click with the macro key: basic attacks cancel animations and restore MP. Putting the basic attack inside the macro loses damage.

title: Each skill preset has its own macro
body: Presets 1–3 each keep a macro, so a solo preset and a dungeon preset can carry different chains.

title: Stigma slots on global: 22, 27, 32, 37
body: Four slots at levels 22, 27, 32 and 37; stigma level cap 20; stigma points start at 23 and reach about 14 by level 36.

title: Conflict: Korea's and Taiwan's stigma slot count
body: Global has 4. KR went to 5 on 2026-03-25 (aion2hub), 6 at level 50 (aion2.run); allthings.how says Taiwan has 6. Don't copy KR stigma sets.

title: Skill points: 21 to reach level 10
body: Level 1 is free; levels 2–4 cost 1, 5–7 cost 2, 8–10 cost 4. 203 points by 45 (about 147 at 36); Wisdom Stones add more.

title: Specializations at skill levels 8, 12, 16 and 20
body: Options unlock at 8, 12 and 16; slots open at 8, 12 and 20. Past 10 only Daevanion, gear and Arcana raise a skill.

title: Skill level gate: one level per 3 character levels
body: A skill gains at most one level every 3 character levels on global, so at 36 nothing is capped below 10.

title: Condemnation needs Chain of Torment; Earth Punishment removes its cooldown
body: Condemnation hits only Chain of Torment targets. From stigma level 5 Earth Punishment makes it crit, and its spec-12 crit reset makes it cooldown-free.

title: Light of Protection and Chain of Torment overlap with a Chanter
body: Light of Protection doesn't stack with Undefeated Mantra; Chain of Torment doesn't apply with Earth's Promise. With a Chanter, swap Light of Protection for Absolution.

title: Conflict: the first solo stigma
body: Earth Punishment first (eloboost24: Light of Protection is a solo mistake) vs Light of Protection first (aion2.run). Verdict: Earth Punishment, then Light of Protection.

title: Conflict: Resurrection or Noble Aura in group stigmas
body: Top level-45 Clerics favour Noble Aura (79%) over Summon Resurrection (64%); keengamer keeps Resurrection until mechanics are clean. Verdict: Resurrection first at 32–36.

title: Conflict: heals or damage first in skill points
body: eloboost24 levels Healing Light and Radiant Recovery first; aion2.run keeps heals at 1 until 34 while leveling. Verdict: damage first solo, heals first for dungeons.

title: Chests need the Cleric's damage too
body: Dungeon chest contribution counts damage (about 5% of the boss's HP) or healing; a Cleric who only heals can leave with nothing.

title: Korean guides run a later version
body: KR: level 50, stigma level 25, extra slots, a ninth class, a reworked macro (May 2026). Use KR guides for class logic, not numbers.
